input_schema.description: A bounded integer matrix over an explicit prime field GF(p), as the canonical `PrimeFieldMatrix` value: `prime` must be a prime integer in [2, 2147483647], `entries` must have at most 256 rows, each row 1..256 columns, all rows the same length matching the declared `columns`, and every entry a canonical residue in [0, prime). Zero rows are permitted and carry the explicit `columns` axis.
